# BetterHermosa — full content

> Everything published on https://betterhermosa.org for the Municipality of Hermosa, Bataan. Independent, volunteer-run portal; not an official government website. Official site: https://www.hermosa.gov.ph.

## Services

### Birth Certificate Registration
URL: https://betterhermosa.org/services/birth-certificate-registration
Registration of a child's birth and issuance of a certified copy of the birth certificate through the Municipal Civil Registrar's Office.
NOTE: Unverified: this entry is a draft based on the 2025 Citizen’s Charter and has not yet been confirmed with the office. Check requirements and fees with the office before you go.
Requirements:
- Certificate of Live Birth (accomplished and signed by attendant at birth)
- Marriage certificate of parents (if married)
- Valid ID of parent(s) or informant
- Affidavit of Acknowledgment/Admission of Paternity (for children of unmarried parents, if applicable)
Steps:
1. Submit the Certificate of Live Birth form accomplished by the attending physician, midwife, or hospital
2. Present required supporting documents to the Civil Registrar
3. Pay applicable registration fee (free of charge if registered within 30 days of birth per law)
4. Receive the registered Certificate of Live Birth; request a certified copy from the PSA (via the civil registrar) if needed
Processing time: Same day for timely registration; longer for late registration
Fee: Free within 30 days of birth; late registration fee applies thereafter

### Business Permit (New Application / Renewal)
URL: https://betterhermosa.org/services/business-permit-new-renewal
Mayor's Permit to operate a business within Hermosa, issued or renewed annually through the Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO).
NOTE: Unverified: this entry is a draft based on the 2025 Citizen’s Charter and has not yet been confirmed with the office. Check requirements and fees with the office before you go.
Requirements:
- Barangay Business Clearance
- DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration (sole proprietorship) or SEC Certificate (partnership/corporation)
- Valid government-issued ID of the owner/representative
- Lease contract or proof of property ownership for the business location
- Previous year's Business Permit and Official Receipt (for renewal)
- Fire Safety Inspection Certificate
- Sanitary Permit / Health Certificate for applicable businesses
Steps:
1. Secure barangay business clearance from the barangay where the business is located
2. Submit application (new) or renewal form with required documents to BPLO
3. Settle assessed fees (business tax, Mayor's Permit fee, and related regulatory fees) at the Treasurer's Office
4. Secure clearances from Sanitary/Health, Fire Safety, and Zoning offices as applicable to the business type
5. Claim the approved Business Permit and Official Receipt
Processing time: Varies — confirm with BPLO
Who can apply: Business owners operating within Hermosa, Bataan

### Certificate of Indigency
URL: https://betterhermosa.org/services/certificate-of-indigency
Certification issued by MSWD confirming a resident's indigent status, commonly required for medical, educational, or burial assistance applications.
NOTE: Unverified: this entry is a draft based on the 2025 Citizen’s Charter and has not yet been confirmed with the office. Check requirements and fees with the office before you go.
Requirements:
- Valid government-issued ID
- Barangay Certificate of Residency or Indigency (from the applicant's barangay)
- Proof of purpose (e.g., hospital bill, school requirement, burial request)
Steps:
1. Request an interview and assessment at the MSWD office
2. Submit required supporting documents
3. Receive the signed Certificate of Indigency
Processing time: Same day, subject to case assessment
Fee: Free

### PWD ID Registration
URL: https://betterhermosa.org/services/pwd-id-registration
Registration and issuance of a Persons with Disability (PWD) identification card through the Person with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO), entitling holders to discounts and benefits under RA 10754.
NOTE: Unverified: this entry is a draft based on the 2025 Citizen’s Charter and has not yet been confirmed with the office. Check requirements and fees with the office before you go.
Requirements:
- Medical Certificate from a licensed physician specifying the disability
- Valid government-issued ID or Birth Certificate
- 2 pieces 1x1 ID photo
- Barangay Certificate of Residency
Steps:
1. Accomplish the PWD registration form at PDAO
2. Submit medical certificate and supporting documents
3. Have 1x1 ID photo taken on site or submit as required
4. Claim the PWD ID card once released
Processing time: Varies — confirm with PDAO
Fee: Free
Validity: Subject to renewal per DOH/NCDA guidelines

### Real Property Tax Payment
URL: https://betterhermosa.org/services/real-property-tax-payment
Payment of annual or quarterly real property tax (RPT) on land, buildings, and other improvements within Hermosa, processed at the Municipal Treasurer's Office.
NOTE: Unverified: this entry is a draft based on the 2025 Citizen’s Charter and has not yet been confirmed with the office. Check requirements and fees with the office before you go.
Requirements:
- Tax Declaration Number or copy of Tax Declaration
- Previous year's Official Receipt (if available)
- Valid ID of the payor
Steps:
1. Bring the property's Tax Declaration number or previous Official Receipt to the Treasurer's Office
2. Request assessment/computation of amount due for the current period
3. Pay in full (eligible for discount if paid early in the year) or in quarterly installments
4. Receive the Official Receipt as proof of payment
Processing time: Same day
Appointment type: Walk-in
